links.explanation: Both reports concern the lack of proper standard operating procedures for managing worsening patients in the renal unit. The later report notes that there is insufficient evidence those procedural shortcomings have been resolved.
links.earlier_quote: There were no applicable standard operating procedures for worsening patients in the renal unit at the date of Jason's death and none had been implemented by the date of Inquest.
links.later_quote: There was insufficient evidence before the court to indicate that the above failings found at Inquest had been addressed by the hospital.
